prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1157; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Conroe, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact pushed me forward against my seatbelt and then snapped my head back. I got out and spoke with the other driver and the responding officer, and I have described the event the same way every time I have been asked about it. I am the named driver on the policy for the vehicle I was operating. Within a few hours my neck and upper back were stiff and sore, and by the next morning I had a headache and pain turning my head. I was diagnosed with whiplash and have been attending physical therapy since. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed.
